description: This file defines a React functional component called SidebarFilters which provides a user interface for filtering some data based on search text, visibility of missing or obsolete items, and severity levels. It manages user input events to call onChange with updated filter states.

methods.name: SidebarFilters
methods.description: React functional component rendering filter controls allowing users to specify search terms, toggle visibility of missing/obsolete items, and select severity levels. Calls onChange callback with updated filters when inputs change.
